detail.longDescription: When developing the same package for R and Python, should I put them in one github repo or separate repos? What's making it a tad bit trickier is that the python package is called good_name , and the r package is called good.name , so they're not identical. Putting them in the same one makes it easier for people to find and use and reference; but putting them in the same one makes it neater. What do you think is the best practice? Thanks!
